# Password Generator 1.5.2

This patch release focuses on privacy hardening, regression coverage, source cleanup and stricter CI/security validation without changing user-facing functionality or UI/UX.

## Privacy & reliability
- Disabled Android application backup as defense in depth while retaining explicit backup and device-transfer exclusions for generator preferences.
- Added regression coverage that verifies every enabled character group is represented even at the minimum password length.

## Maintenance
- Simplified the Compose hierarchy and source imports, removed an unused Compose preview dependency, and cleaned haptic, debounce and repeat-detection code without changing behavior.
- Qodana now performs the same strict full-project scan on pull requests as on `main`, with `qodana.recommended`, `failThreshold: 0`, and only narrowly scoped exclusions for confirmed false positives.
- Updated CodeQL Action to 4.37.9 and `actions/download-artifact` to 8.0.1 while keeping immutable SHA pins.

The password generation logic, privacy model, application features and interface remain functionally unchanged.
